A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|'''Dark Jedi''']]''' Master''' served the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. During the war's [[Battle of Rakata Prime|final battle]], the Dark Jedi was stationed aboard the [[Star Forge]], the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] under Malak's control which fueled the Empire's war effort. He monitored the former Dark Lord and redeemed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] aboard the Star Forge during the battle, and reported to Malak on Revan's progress.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Jedi Master was featured in the [[2003]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.
